title: Rental Class Specifications and Renter Requirements (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
Each Rental Vehicle Coordination class carries its own seating, luggage capacity, renter age limits, young-renter fee, accepted cards and card hold. A class is open to a renter only where the renter is at least the class minimum age; the Economy, Compact, Intermediate and Full-Size Rental classes must also seat the party, the Standard SUV Rental and Minivan Rental classes accept a credit card only, and the Minivan Rental seats seven.

## Class specification sheet

| Rental class | Seats | Large suitcases | Minimum renter age (years) | Highest age for the young-renter fee (years) | Young-renter fee (USD per rental day) | Accepted cards | Card hold at pickup (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Rental | 5 | 2 | 21 | 24 | 25.00 | Credit card, debit card | 200.00 |
| Compact Rental | 5 | 2 | 21 | 24 | 25.00 | Credit card, debit card | 200.00 |
| Intermediate Rental | 5 | 3 | 21 | 24 | 25.00 | Credit card, debit card | 200.00 |
| Full-Size Rental | 5 | 4 | 21 | 24 | 25.00 | Credit card, debit card | 250.00 |
| Standard SUV Rental | 5 | 4 | 23 | 24 | 30.00 | Credit card only | 300.00 |
| Minivan Rental | 7 | 6 | 23 | 24 | 30.00 | Credit card only | 300.00 |

## Entry conditions of each class

| Rental class | Entry conditions |
|---|---|
| Economy, Compact, Intermediate and Full-Size Rental | Renter at least the class minimum age; the class seat count meets the party |
| Standard SUV Rental | Renter at least the class minimum age; payment by credit card only |
| Minivan Rental | Renter at least the class minimum age; payment by credit card only; seats seven |

## Meaning of each column

- **Seats** and **large suitcases**: the seats in the class and the large suitcases the class holds.
- **Minimum renter age**: the minimum age of the renter, in years.
- **Highest age for the young-renter fee**: the highest age at which the young-renter fee applies.
- **Young-renter fee**: the young-renter fee per rental day, always paid by the customer.
- **Accepted cards**: the cards accepted for the customer's share and the hold.
- **Card hold**: the authorization hold placed on the renter's card at pickup and released at settlement.

## Hypothetical readings

- A renter aged 22 meets the minimum age of 21 for an Intermediate Rental but not the minimum age of 23 for a Standard SUV Rental.
- A renter aged 24 is at the highest age for the young-renter fee in every class; a renter aged 25 is above it.
- A party of six is seated by the Minivan Rental's 7 seats and not by the 5 seats of any other class.
